remaining_blocking_bugs.title: Empty model definition bindings bypass source identity checks
remaining_blocking_bugs.evidence: The guard checks name membership then f.get(definition_id)!=bindings[name]. With bindings={x:None} and no definition_id in the field, both sides are None. An empty-string binding and empty-string field definition also pass. Both cases return 19.0 in the synthetic one-feature fixture.
remaining_blocking_bugs.impact: A supplied frozen model can produce inference without an identified source definition, bypassing the model helper source-binding contract. The integration manifest currently blocks execution; this remains a unit-helper defect.
remaining_blocking_bugs.fix: Require every model feature binding to be a nonempty string and require an explicitly matching nonempty field definition_id before any inference. Fail closed or raise ValueError for malformed bindings.

remaining_blocking_bugs.title: Exit constant condition is not checked for boolean type
remaining_blocking_bugs.evidence: validate_rule adds exit.condition to expressions and validates its AST, but boolean checks iterate only entry and optional invalidation. exit={condition:{const:1}} passes validation.
remaining_blocking_bugs.impact: An invalid declared exit survives the schema boundary, leaving consumers to choose truthiness versus rejection. evaluate_rule does not evaluate exits, so it cannot later supply the type guard used for entry.
remaining_blocking_bugs.fix: Include exit.condition in boolean-constant validation. Any eventual exit evaluator must enforce boolean result types for nonconstant expressions too.
